synopsis: AgriGen generates large agricultural scenes in Isaac Sim and is identified in Chapter 5 as reported in September 2026 [f16007, f3788, f4142]. The glossary places it alongside CropCraft and Boreal3D as supporting agricultural and forest scenes, while Chapter 5 includes it in the strong off-road record for procedural site generation [f16086, f4194]. However, AgriGen (2026) describes simulating fields with thousands of vegetation assets as computationally intractable on consumer-grade hardware, highlighting a scaling constraint [f3895]. The cited agricultural examples, including AgriGen, do not establish applicability to heavy construction-machine braking [f4148].
